notes: All 7 items now pass, including retention, which is real working tested code, not just a config value. One residual caveat carried forward rather than hidden: the retention code needs to actually be deployed (container rebuild) before it enforces anything in the running system; until then the mechanism is proven but dormant. Recommend deploying it before or shortly after confirmatory collection begins at 200-trial scale, since that volume will accelerate disk growth well beyond the current pilot's rate. This remains a single-reviewer self-review, not independent peer review; noting that limitation for the paper rather than presenting it as fully independent.
